title: Complete Distribution Alpha final audit and promotion decision
purpose: Audit all Distribution Alpha gates and decide whether the Alpha image can be promoted or must remain blocked.
scope: Verify every TASK-DALPHA task has evidence.
Run inherited runtime, safety, AgentCore, adversarial, release, and QEMU gates.
Verify rootfs runtime manifest and release provenance coverage.
Verify generated artifacts are ignored or intentionally documented.
Record promotion decision or blocking risks.
acceptance_criteria: All Alpha TASK JSON statuses are completed or explicitly deferred with blocking risks.
Required gates have direct command output evidence.
QEMU smoke verifies boot and runtime availability.
Release provenance includes runtime manifest and image inputs.
No unrelated WIP or generated artifacts are committed.
risk_notes: Final audit must prove completion from current evidence, not infer it from passing narrow tests.
implementation_steps: Parse workflow JSON and task statuses.
Write final audit and promotion decision.
failure_modes: Final audit treats dependency checks as full QEMU smoke.
Final audit ignores generated artifact drift.
Final audit promotes despite missing rootfs manifest evidence.
Final audit marks Alpha complete while isolation tasks remain unproven.

verification_matrix.command: cargo test -p agentd && cargo test -p agentd safety:: && cargo test -p agentd agent_core:: && cargo test -p agentd agent_core::adversarial && pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-release.ps1
verification_matrix.expected: All inherited runtime and release gates pass
Boot and packaged runtime markers are observed

blocked_until: All gates pass or blocking risks are explicit.
